import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter1 = ax1.scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                       c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='YlOrRd', s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality\n(colored by Stress Level)', fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter1, ax=ax1, label='Stress Level')

# 2. Physical Activity Level distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.hist(df['Physical Activity Level'], bins=15, color=colors[1], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity Distribution', fontweight='bold')

# 3. BMI Category distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors[:len(bmi_counts)], startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontweight='bold')

# 4. Heart Rate by BMI Category
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
bmi_present = [cat for cat in bmi_order if cat in df['BMI Category'].unique()]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Heart Rate', ax=ax4, 
            palette='Set2', order=bmi_present)
ax4.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Heart Rate by BMI Category', fontweight='bold')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)

# 5. Daily Steps by Occupation
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
occupation_steps = df.groupby('Occupation')['Daily Steps'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
ax5.barh(occupation_steps.index, occupation_steps.values, color=colors[3], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Average Daily Steps', fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Average Daily Steps by Occupation', fontweight='bold')

# 6. Sleep Disorder distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
sleep_disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
bars = ax6.bar(range(len(sleep_disorder_counts)), sleep_disorder_counts.values, 
               color=colors[4], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(sleep_disorder_counts)))
ax6.set_xticklabels(sleep_disorder_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax6.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Count', fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontweight='bold')

# 7. Stress Level vs Sleep Quality
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax7.scatter(df['Stress Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
           s=df['Age']*5, c=colors[5], alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax7.set_xlabel('Stress Level', fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Stress vs Sleep Quality\n(size by Age)', fontweight='bold')

# 8. Age distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
ax8.hist(df['Age'], bins=10, color=colors[6], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax8.set_xlabel('Age', fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_title('Age Distribution', fontweight='bold')

# 9. Correlation heatmap
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, ax=ax9, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, square=True)
ax9.set_title('Correlation Matrix', fontweight='bold')
plt.setp(ax9.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
plt.setp(ax9.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=8)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
